sources.title: GGUF-Models (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GGUF is a modern file format for storing models optimized for efficient inference, particularly on consumer-grade hardware. This makes it easier for researchers, developers, and hobbyists to experiment with and deploy large language models.
